headline: On 3 harder batches (10-12 stories, x2 reps) the planner arm passed 6/6 and plain Haiku 5/6, but the planner arm used 2.7x the tokens (656k -> 1,747k). The one A failure is debatable (it held an independent story whose AC needs HR sign-off). The planner's own output was wrong on h2-portal (endpoint with a trailing period), and the agents corrected it. That bug is open.

arms.name: Plain Claude (reads batch JSON, told no planner is available)
Claude + story-batch-planner (plan.mjs --summary with PLAN_JSON line, Jev shadow on)
arms.engineVersion: typesafe/jev-1.13 via OpenRouter decisions API, shadow only

evaluation.datasetVersion: cases/h1-payroll.json, h2-portal.json, h3-hr.json (new, written for this run, no answer key inside)
evaluation.tokenScope: all tokens of each case agent session (input + output + cache read + cache write), from its subagent transcript
deviations: Gold invariants live only in grade.mjs, which was written after all 12 case agents had finished; the batch copies have no expected block.
Arm A was told "No planner tool is available"; subagent_usage.mjs --forbid "story-batch-planner|plan.mjs" found 0 forbidden calls in all 6 arm-A transcripts, so no A run was discarded.
Two repetitions, rep 2 launched B first; 3 cases: directional only.

h3-hr A r2 fails only because the agent held R-10 (independent) in needs_decision, reasoning that its AC "approved by HR" needs a human; strictly a scheduling error, but a defensible call. Without that invariant both arms pass 6/6.

The planner's raw output fails h2-portal (Q-4 producer scheduled together with consumers Q-5/Q-6, trailing-period bug in endpoint extraction, see agent-review.json). Every B agent overrode it; the score is of the agent's answer, not the planner output. The planner also schedules incomplete stories (R-1, P-8, Q-11) in a wave of their own, while all agents simply held them.
B-arm token spread is wide (112k to 634k per case): h1 B r2 used 10 tool calls auditing the planner; h1 B r1 used 2.
Planner and fixes measured at commit aff05cf on branch claude/sbp-fix-rework (not merged); the run used this session's worktree checkout.
One planner run per B case (one log line each); Jev shadow calls per case come from the wrapper log.
